metadata.description: One plugin that splits a task into subtasks, routes each to a predefined agent on the right model, and scaffolds new agents and agent plugins.

plugins.name: foreman
plugins.description: 2 skills (dispatch, new-agent), 10 agent types with per-kind model and effort defaults, 7 task templates, a plan checker, a run log with tune hints, a plan-to-Workflow compiler and an agent-file linter.
